turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a custodial account or a junior investment account in your name for him could work, depending on where you live.

turns.text: He wants to buy one company's shares. The one that makes his games console.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a fun way to learn, but explain that one company is risky. A broad index fund spreads the risk across many.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let him put a small part into the company and the rest into the fund. He gets the excitement and learns about diversifying.
